::: {.page-header}
# News
Writing from the Indonesian open source geospatial community
:::

::: {.section-block}
::: {.content-container}

Event reports, tutorials, project updates, and community news — written by
members of the chapter. Every post carries its author's name, and the full
edit history of each one is public on
[GitHub](https://github.com/osgeoid/osgeoid.github.io/commits/master/posts).

**Want to write for the site?** See the
[contributing guide](https://github.com/osgeoid/osgeoid.github.io/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
You keep the byline, and your name appears both on the post and in the
repository's contributor history.

:::
